title: Needs you says how long a mission has been without work as of now, not as of when its alert fired
prompt:
Read web/src/home.ts (`needsYou`: an alert's item and its `detail`; `ageText`) and crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs (the `mission_idle` alert: its text and its evidence's `since_ms`).

The problem. Objective 058's `mission_idle` alert is live. Mission #6's fired at 2026-11-11 16:54Z, and its text says "mission #6 has had no task in work for 21 h 25 min since its last task ended: its objective backlog has nothing open to assign" (read-only /api/alerts; rev-b's 058 live check). Needs you shows an alert's text as it was when the alert fired. So the item still says "21 h 25 min" an hour later, a day later, and for as long as the alert stays open, while the mission's real idle time keeps growing. The alert's evidence already carries `since_ms`, when the mission's last task ended.

Required behaviour.
(a) In Needs you, a `mission_idle` item's detail is "<subject> has had no task in work for <how long> since its last task ended: its objective backlog has nothing open to assign". <how long> is now less the evidence's `since_ms`, in the page's own words (home.ts `ageText`: "25 min", "31 h", "3 d"), worked out each time the page renders.
(b) An alert whose evidence has no numeric `since_ms` keeps its text, and every other alert is as today.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/071.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it: mission 1 takes its work from a backlog, and its one task was cancelled 31 h ago. Its `mission_idle` alert is seeded as the alert step writes it, fired 15 min after that, with the words of that moment. `spawn serve` answers `GET /api/alerts` and `GET /api/missions`.
- (1) Under node, needsYou's mission_idle item over those answers reads "... for 31 h since ..." 31 h after `since_ms`, "3 d" 72 h after and "25 min" 25 min after. Without `since_ms` it keeps the alert's text ("15 min").
It fails with 1 on ecb177ab: the item says "15 min" at every time.

The product reason. An idle mission is a loss that grows by the hour, and the owner weighs how urgent it is by how long it has lasted. A figure frozen at the alert's firing understates it more each hour it stays open.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green and add web/test tests of your own for (a) and (b).
